definitions.explanation: An angle of 180 degrees, formed by two rays pointing in exactly opposite directions so that they make a straight line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{直角|ちょっかく}→直角：05444_chokkaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{平角|へいかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Two right angles together make a straight angle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一直線|いっちょくせん}→一直線：06953_icchokusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{半直線|はんちょくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つくる{角|かく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{平角|へいかく}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: The angle formed by two rays lying in a straight line is called a straight angle.

notes:
Composed of {平|へい} (flat, level) + {角|かく} (angle). A mathematics term for an angle of exactly 180 degrees.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{直角|ちょっかく}→直角：05444_chokkaku⟧: right angle — 90 degrees
- ⟦{鋭角|えいかく}→鋭角：05554_eikaku⟧: acute angle — less than 90 degrees
- ⟦{鈍角|どんかく}→鈍角：05555_donkaku⟧: obtuse angle — between 90 and 180 degrees
